payload.criterion: Loaded design for this repo has suite.mode=full and suite.gate=advisory and a command containing pytest tests
payload.verify_command: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; d=json.loads(Path('contract/project-design.json').read_text()); s=d['phase_gate']['suite']; assert s['mode']=='full' and s['gate']=='advisory' and 'pytest' in s['command']"
